lines.text: Many learners say: He said me the truth.
Better: He told me the truth.
Told! She told me a secret.

native.tip: Com a pessoa logo depois do verbo, use “tell”: “told me”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “He said me the truth.”. O certo é “He told me the truth.”. “Disse-me” vira “told me”, não “said me”. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “told”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: When a person comes right after the verb, use “tell”: “told me”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “He said me the truth.”. The right way is “He told me the truth.”. “Disse-me” becomes “told me”, not “said me”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
